summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing daily open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares under the buyback programme announced 31 July 2026, executed through broker Goldman Sachs International. Across 12–16 October 2026 the company bought 38,000,000 shares, with a volume-weighted average price per share ranging from about 103.37p to 106.08p and highest price paid 107.50p; shares will be cancelled. Disclosures follow UK Market Abuse Regulation Article 5(1)(b). Watch execution pace and cancellation-driven share-count reduction.
